payload.text: RESUME STATE (ic, localfold on hv's word, relayed by vc at 13:17:41Z by vc's clock: "Ok, context is high. Let's corale a localfold across the nodes here, then we can continue with the plans on the bounce."): ST0086 WP-04 Part B, the page face of AC-04.6, on vc's orders at 10:40Z and 11:08Z (vc's word). refs/bank/ic/0086/wp04b-page-v2 (blob a10e09b24211, patch-id 8126a568631b) sits over cc's B1 v2 + B2 v2: refs/bank/cc/0086/wp04b-status-v2 (patch-id 4ae2585f7479) and wp04b-wait-v2 (patch-id 2421b3d9719d). ic measured during this fold that all three still apply in order on main fab3a4801, giving tree 2a0c64d3ac39. vc confirmed the bank at 11:14Z. It lands third in Part B's train, after B1 v2 and B2 v2 and before B3. The train goes after devbin-vc's push, as the first run molt-vc books through the slot records; hv ruled at 13:16Z that molt-vc takes control after the preflight's END (vc's word). What it does: each lane lists its queued asks under its holders (`lanes[].queue`). A controller.json that will not parse reads `control  record UNREADABLE (named below)` in the band, never NO CONTROLLER, with `controller record UNREADABLE <path> -- <why>` first below the band. The page-keys test requires `controller_unreadable` and carries the lane arm (ST0086 AT-04.6), and the fixture carries both keys. Render tools v3 (refs/bank/ic/tools/render-states.sh 96c9f5840582 and prelude.js 942b1e87c794) draw five states. On main, queued and ctlbad fail until Part B's keys land, as vc's A4 judge also saw. tmp/wt-ic-0086b (index tree 5505c7977f57) is kept until the landing. Part B's judge compiles the Rust arm; a red comes back to ic to fix forward there, and if B1 v2 or B2 v2 moves, ic re-banks over the new tree. No claim: the work package is cc's. No push, no release.
